resources.title: Destination Story Planner
resources.subject: Your Destination Story Planner
resources.emailIntro: Here is the Destination Story Planner you asked for. It walks you through turning one trip you have taken into four weeks of content in your own voice.
resources.emailNote: Pick one trip, write quickly, and polish later. If a question stops you, reply and tell me where.

resources.title: Relationship-Driven Advisor Starter Guide
resources.subject: Your Relationship-Driven Advisor Starter Guide
resources.emailIntro: Here is the Relationship-Driven Advisor Starter Guide you asked for. It covers how to build trusted relationships with local partners and how to turn them into trips your clients ask for.
resources.emailNote: Start with the questions on page 3 and try them in your next conversation with a partner. I would love to hear what you learn.

resources.title: Look Inside The Conscious Creator
resources.subject: A Look Inside The Conscious Creator
resources.emailIntro: Here is the look inside The Conscious Creator that you asked for: five days in Akumal and Tulum, February 8 to 12, 2027, with the people and places behind them.
resources.emailNote: Seats are limited and selected by application. If it feels like a fit, I would be glad to read yours.
